function daysAgoISO(d){ return new Date(now.getTime() - (Number(d)*86400000)).toISOString().slice(0,10); }

let rows = [];
if (CONFIG.mode === "LIVE") {
  rows = (CONFIG.live_companies || []).map(function(c){
    const o = Object.assign({}, c);
    o.data_label = "LIVE INPUT";
    o.evidence_label = "PUBLIC FACT (pending validation)";
    return o;
  });
} else {
  rows = DEMO.map(function(c){
    const o = Object.assign({}, c);
    o.signal_date = daysAgoISO(c.days_ago);
    o.data_label = "DEMO DATA - NOT ASG CUSTOMER DATA";
    o.evidence_label = "SIMULATED DATA";
    delete o.days_ago;
    return o;
  });
}

if (!rows.length) {
  return [{ json: { status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", review_reasons: ["NO_INPUT_ACCOUNTS"],

    run_mode: CONFIG.mode, workflow_version: CONFIG.workflow_version } }];
}

return rows.map(function(r){
  return { json: Object.assign({ run_mode: CONFIG.mode, workflow_version: CONFIG.workflow_version,
    research_date: new Date().toISOString(), status: "OK", review_reasons: [] }, r) };
});

const CONFIG = $('2. Load CONFIG').first().json.config;
const now = new Date().toISOString();

return $input.all().map(function(item){
  const j = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(item.json));
  const top = j.strongest_signal_object;
  const a = j.analysis || {};

  const crm = {
    Account: j.company_name,
    Account_Website: j.website,
    Account_Industry: j.industry,
    Account_Property_Count: j.property_count,
    Account_Employee_Count: j.employee_count,
    Account_Location: j.location,
    ICP_Score: j.icp_score,
    ICP_Tier: j.icp_tier,
    Signal: top ? top.signal_name : "NONE",
    Signal_Date: top ? top.source_date : "",
    Signal_Source: top ? top.source_title : "",
    Signal_Source_URL: top ? top.source_url : "",
    Signal_Type: top ? top.signal_category : "",
    Signal_Strength: top ? top.signal_strength : 0,
    Signal_Freshness_Band: j.best_freshness_band,
    All_Signals: (j.signals_scored || []).map(function(s){ return s.signal_name; }).join("; "),
    Opportunity_Score: j.opportunity_score,
    Priority: j.priority,
    Potential_Product: (a.potential_actabl_fit || []).join("; "),
    Potential_Product_Label: "POTENTIAL PRODUCT FIT (hypothesis, not a verified customer need)",
    Sales_Play: j.sales_play,
    Persona: j.recommended_persona,
    Secondary_Personas: (j.secondary_personas || []).join("; "),
    Why_Now: a.why_now || "",
    Business_Problem_Hypothesis: a.business_problem_hypothesis || "",
    Evidence: (a.evidence || []).map(function(e){ return e.source_title + " | " + e.source_url + " | " + e.source_date; }).join(" || "),
    Personalization_Angle: j.personalization_angle,
    Recommended_Action: a.recommended_next_action || "",
    Confidence: a.confidence,
    Research_Date: j.research_date,
    Created_At: now,
    Workflow_Version: CONFIG.workflow_version,
    Portfolio_Company: CONFIG.portfolio_company,
    Model_Confidence: a.confidence,
    Analysis_Source: j.analysis_source,
    Data_Label: j.data_label,
    Status: j.status,
    Review_Reasons: (j.review_reasons || []).join("; "),
    Dedup_Key: j.company_key + "|" + (top ? top.signal_name : "NONE"),
    Salesforce_Mapping_Hint: "Account -> Account.Name, Signal -> Custom Object Signal__c, Opportunity_Score -> Opportunity_Score__c, Dedup_Key -> External_Id__c (upsert key)."
  };

  return { json: {
    company_name: j.company_name,
    website: j.website,
    icp_score: j.icp_score,
    opportunity_score: j.opportunity_score,
    priority: j.priority,
    strongest_signal: j.strongest_signal,
    signal_count: j.signal_count,
    signal_categories: j.signal_categories,
    sales_play: j.sales_play,
    recommended_persona: j.recommended_persona,
    potential_actabl_fit: a.potential_actabl_fit || [],
    personalization_angle: j.personalization_angle,
    status: j.status,
    review_reasons: j.review_reasons,
    data_label: j.data_label,
    analysis: a,
    opportunity_score_breakdown: j.opportunity_score_breakdown,
    icp_breakdown: j.icp_breakdown,
    signals_scored: j.signals_scored,
    signals_rejected: j.signals_rejected,
    potential_product_fit: j.potential_product_fit,
    sales_play_qualification: j.sales_play_qualification,
    persona_ranking: j.persona_ranking,
    outreach_structure_check: j.outreach_structure_check,
    crm_record: crm,
    audit: {
      created_at: now,
      research_date: j.research_date,
      workflow_version: CONFIG.workflow_version,
      portfolio_company: CONFIG.portfolio_company,
      run_mode: j.run_mode,
      analysis_source: j.analysis_source,
      model_confidence: a.confidence,
      research_source: j.research_source,
      documents_reviewed: j.documents_reviewed,
      source_urls: (a.evidence || []).map(function(e){ return e.source_url; })
    }
  }};
});
